document_title.description: Title of the guidance document from the cover page, e.g. 'Deciding When to Submit a 510(k) for a Change to an Existing Device'

issuing_agency.description: Agency that issued the guidance, as printed at the foot of the cover page

issue_date.description: Date the final guidance was issued, from the cover page, as YYYY-MM-DD

flowcharts.description: One entry per flowchart figure in the document, in page order

figure_caption.description: The figure caption printed beneath the flowchart, exactly as printed, e.g. 'Figure 2 - Flowchart A: Labeling Changes'

chart_letter.description: The chart's letter (A, B, C or D) from its caption, or null for the main flowchart

entry_point.description: Text of the start terminal at the top of the chart, e.g. 'From Main Chart', or null if the chart has none

decisions.description: Every decision (diamond) box in the chart

node_id.description: The identifier printed above the question inside the diamond, e.g. 'A1.2'; null if the diamond has none

question.description: The question inside the diamond, exactly as printed

if_yes.description: Where the Yes arrow leads: the node_id of the next decision, the text of the outcome box (e.g. 'New 510(k)', 'Documentation'), or the chart it sends you to (e.g. 'Go to Chart A')

if_no.description: Where the No arrow leads, in the same form as if_yes
